name: neon-border
blurb: Glowing neon border, optionally sweeping around the perimeter.
description: Wraps children in a neon-glowing border made of two custom colours with drop-shadow blur. The border can stay static, sweep halfway around, or cycle fully around the perimeter. Driven by CSS animation.
use_when: A hero card or high-impact CTA that should stand out with that cyberpunk neon aesthetic.
avoid_when: Delicate or minimal designs where the bright glow would feel out of place.
a11y: Wrapper only; no interactive elements or focus handling.
